messages:
Maria K: Quick check — postmortem action slate for INC-834. I pulled the RCA items into the spreadsheet and flagged cross-team deps. Can folks confirm ownership + a target date? If blocked, say so and why.
Aj Patel: I own the DB migration task (item 3). Targeting Wed EOD next week (2026-04-21). Blocker: waiting on 2 hours of maintenance window from infra.
Luke T: I can take the rollout gating checklist (item 5). Planning a canary on Tue morning. Will update the playbook with the exact commands.
Kevin S: I'm listed for the observability alert tuning (item 2) — due Fri. Heads up: need access to the dedicated log index from platform team (ticket #PL-492).
Maria K: @Kevin S noted. @platform-team can you confirm PL-492 ETA?
Tara (oncall): FYI I'm oncall Thu-Fri next week; if any canary needs immediate rollback, ping me. Also, I can run the cutover if Aj's maintenance window lands in my shift.
incident-bot: Reminder: INC-834 follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-04-22 14:00 UTC. Autogenerated checklist status: 3/7 done.
Aj Patel: @Tara (oncall) thanks — window requested, awaiting approval. If approval delayed, I can do a partial migration with feature flag to reduce blast radius.
Maria K: Good fallback. Please add the feature-flag plan (1-2 lines) into the spreadsheet under 'risk mitigation'.
Luke T: Added the playbook snippet and the canary commands:
```
# canary rollout
kubectl apply -f canary-deploy.yaml --namespace=prod-canary
monitor --query "error_rate>0.5%" --window 5m
if stable: kubectl rollout restart deployment/main
```
Kevin S: Platform team replied: PL-492 assigned to @Sam P, ETA 2026-04-19. Sam, can you add brief acceptance criteria?
Maria K: Thanks @Sam P if you see this. Also tagging @security for the data-retention check (item 6) — is there any compliance hold?
Aj Patel: Quick note: migration script will log to a temp index, will delete after verification. Keeping retention policy = 7d for the temp index.
Luke T: One more ask — can we get a quick regression test sign-off from eng-ml on Tue AM? The model endpoint changes are minor but want a sanity pass. @eng-ml PTL please advise.
Tara (oncall): I'll be available Tue AM for regression windows if needed.
Kevin S: Updated the spreadsheet with my ETA + acceptance criteria.
Maria K: Everyone listed as owners, thanks. I'll do a final sweep tomorrow and ping the cross-team meeting if anything slips. If you can't meet your ETA, post here with a new date. :thumbsup:
